lenses.name: Biggest pain
lenses.question: What is the single most frequent or most intense complaint, and what would remove it entirely rather than soften it?

lenses.name: Workaround hunt
lenses.question: What spreadsheets, copy-paste rituals, screenshots, or second tools do users rely on around this product? Which job does that workaround reveal?

lenses.name: Adjacent jobs
lenses.question: What do users do right before and right after using the product? Which of those steps could the product absorb?

lenses.name: The person who left
lenses.question: Why did the last users who stopped using it stop, and what would have kept them?

lenses.name: Power user
lenses.question: What do the heaviest users do that nobody designed for? What would make them 10x faster?

lenses.name: First five minutes
lenses.question: What happens in a new user's first five minutes, and what is the earliest moment they could feel the core value?

lenses.name: Underserved segment
lenses.question: Which segment (students, Korean small businesses, a specific profession, older users, non-English speakers) has the job but is badly served today?

lenses.name: Emotional and social job
lenses.question: Beyond the functional task, how do users want to feel or be seen while doing it? What would serve that?

lenses.name: Competitors' one-star reviews
lenses.question: What do competitors' angriest reviews complain about, and could we be the product that fixes exactly that?

lenses.name: What incumbents can't do
lenses.question: What would the market leader never do because it would hurt their existing business model or customers?

lenses.name: Give away what they charge for
lenses.question: What do competitors charge for that we could give away (or the reverse: what do they give away that is worth charging for)?

lenses.name: The open-source alternative
lenses.question: What does the best free or open-source alternative do well, and what does its user still suffer from?

lenses.name: Beat doing nothing
lenses.question: Most users' real alternative is doing nothing. What would make acting today obviously better than doing nothing?

lenses.name: Another industry's solution
lenses.question: Which other industry solves a structurally similar job (logistics, banking, games, healthcare, retail)? What mechanism could we borrow?

lenses.name: The physical-world version
lenses.question: How is this job done offline, with paper, in person, or by a human assistant? What does that version get right?

lenses.name: Game design
lenses.question: How would a game designer make this loop satisfying: feedback, progression, mastery, collection, social play?

lenses.name: New AI capability
lenses.question: Which task in this product could a current model do end-to-end for the user? What would it mean to delegate it entirely?

lenses.name: New platform API
lenses.question: Which recent OS, browser, app store, or platform capability (Naver, Kakao, Google, Apple) opens something that was impossible a year ago?

lenses.name: Regulation shift
lenses.question: Which new rule (privacy, AI labeling, data portability, accessibility) creates a burden users will pay to have handled?

lenses.name: Falling cost
lenses.question: What became 10x cheaper recently (compute, storage, inference, bandwidth)? What becomes possible if we assume it is free?

lenses.name: Move the free line
lenses.question: Where exactly is the free-to-paid line today, and what happens if we move it up, down, or to a different value metric?

lenses.name: Usage-based pricing
lenses.question: What if users paid per unit of value delivered instead of per seat or per month?

lenses.name: Team and education plans
lenses.question: Who would buy this for a group (a lab, a class, a company team)? What would they need that an individual doesn't?

lenses.name: Become a platform
lenses.question: What could third parties build on top of this if we opened it up, and would that make the core more valuable?

lenses.name: Offline only
lenses.question: What if it had to work fully offline? What would we simplify, and would users like that version better?

lenses.name: Ten seconds
lenses.question: What if the core job had to be done in ten seconds? What would we cut?

lenses.name: Free forever
lenses.question: What if it could never charge users? How would it sustain itself, and what does that reveal about where value sits?

lenses.name: One screen
lenses.question: What if the whole product had to fit on one screen?

lenses.name: No account
lenses.question: What if users could get value without signing up? How far could they go?

lenses.name: For a 70-year-old
lenses.question: What if the main user were 70 and new to technology? What would become obvious that is hidden today?

lenses.name: Used by an AI agent
lenses.question: What if the main user were another AI agent acting for a person? What interface and guarantees would it need?

lenses.name: Built-in sharing
lenses.question: What does a user create or achieve here that they would naturally show someone else? How could showing it bring that person in?

lenses.name: Multiplayer
lenses.question: What if the job were done with others instead of alone? Who would the user invite, and why would they accept?

lenses.name: Data that improves with use
lenses.question: What would get better for every user as more people use it (recommendations, templates, quality signals)?

lenses.name: Content that ranks
lenses.question: What public pages could the product generate that people search for on Google or Naver?

lenses.name: Remove a feature
lenses.question: Which feature would almost nobody miss? What would removing it free up (code, attention, support)?

lenses.name: Make it worse
lenses.question: How would we make this product as frustrating as possible? Now reverse each answer: which reversal is not yet true today?

lenses.name: Opposite of convention
lenses.question: What does every product in this category do? What happens if we do the opposite?

lenses.name: Change the default
lenses.question: Which setting do most users never change? What if the default flipped?

lenses.name: 10x, not 10%
lenses.question: What would make this product unrecognizable, and 10x more valuable, in two years?

lenses.name: New category
lenses.question: If we stopped comparing ourselves to the current category, what category would make our strengths obvious?

lenses.name: Merge with a sibling product
lenses.question: What if this product merged with another product in the portfolio? What new job would the combination do?

lenses.name: Trust and failure
lenses.question: Where could the product embarrass, lose data for, or mislead a user? What would make failure graceful and recovery obvious?

lenses.name: Privacy as a feature
lenses.question: What would a privacy-first version look like, and which segment would choose it for that reason alone?

lenses.name: Accessibility
lenses.question: What would it take for someone using a screen reader, a keyboard only, or low bandwidth to do the core job easily?

lenses.name: Korean context
lenses.question: What would a Korean user expect that a global product misses: KakaoTalk sharing, Naver login or search, Korean holidays and academic calendar, 공인인증 or 본인인증 flows, local payment methods?
